purpose: Contrast two topics across opposing statements.
keywords: A + は + predicate + が; B + は + contrasting predicate.
My older brother is tall, but my younger brother is short.
Summer is hot, but winter is cold.
I drink tea, but I do not drink coffee.
formation: A + は + predicate + が; B + は + contrasting predicate.
restrictions: The contrasted topics and qualities should be understandable from context.
mistake: The connective が and topic は play different roles.
